execution: not run against real agents; human-readable cases for later acceptance

evals.prompt: Join amplifier as backend from this Claude session.
evals.expected_output: Obtain explicit session/project and use the installed helper; report registration versus worker status.

evals.prompt: The worker is offline. Just launch codex directly to answer.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the inbox, report live execution disabled and do not bypass the gate.

evals.prompt: Use Zhenya's subscription from my computer.
evals.expected_output: Keep owner accounts local and require the receiving owner's permissions.

evals.prompt: A start timed out. Retry on another host.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the unknown attempt; do not assume the old process stopped.

evals.prompt: The peer answered. Automatically reply until consensus.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the durable reply without starting an unbounded negotiation.

evals.prompt: From this Codex chat, let the quorum worker join with this invitation and receive messages itself.
evals.expected_output: Brief the native worker with the parent thread UUID; the worker runs accept-id and session connect with --transport tool-inbox --require-worker-inbox, then bounded session receive calls, receipts itself and reports only material results; no session start or background listener. If no worker can be verified, leave the invitation unused and disclose visible parent envelopes/queue cards; do not switch routes without the owner explicitly choosing parent reception.

evals.prompt: In Claude Code, have the subagent receive Quorum messages instead of this chat.
evals.expected_output: Follow references/claude-worker.md: prepare a pending slot, start exactly one actual native background worker, attest its returned handle, and let that worker use its capability file for its own receive and receipt. If background support is unavailable, report native_worker_unavailable once without consuming the invitation and disclose that parent reception shows raw envelopes and queue cards. Use --require-worker-inbox for worker accept/connect; use the parent route only after the owner explicitly chooses it, never label it as a worker inbox.

evals.prompt: Enable debugging for quorum my-project until I stop; automatically file findings in rotnov/skills.
evals.expected_output: Read references/debug.md only because the owner enabled debugging. Activate the inferred quorum, project, and repository, and start or hand off the bounded local watch. A single sample is not complete observation. Report partial coverage honestly, including when the host is not supervising. Do not preload debug instructions for ordinary quorum use, do not treat imported artifacts as live observation, and do not file a finding outside the granted repository.
